| Integration paths | Asset take-on requested from S5 through its contract; CCMS release and Land Office title check through the rwb-integration contract; each returned reference recorded |

| Title-set task | Raised by the parent CaseWorkflow on the reported request, with the 5 working-day clock of R-SET-22; case states moved by the parent |
